findings.highlight: I shall treat you importantly like I did her.
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方も同じよう、大事に大事に扱ってあげる
findings.governingReading: Caster promises to treat him similarly while saying Saber will soon be hers.
findings.explanation: Future treatment like Saber becomes treatment already performed.

findings.evidenceJa: 大事に大事に扱ってあげる
findings.governingReading: Caster promises repeated, exaggerated care while threatening to turn Shirou into a tool, making apparent tenderness part of the menace.
findings.explanation: Caster's promise to take very special care of Shirou becomes “treat you importantly,” losing the natural language of tenderness that sharpens her tool-making threat.
